title: Eric Davis DIA report on teleportation

tellings.quote: is so important. It speak something to that uh that Dr. Eric W. Davis uh published in one of those DIA reports that I saw in teleportage

plain: A Navy scientist named Salvatore Pais, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says he saw a report on teleportation written by a researcher named Eric W. Davis for the DIA, the Defense Intelligence Agency, which gathers military intelligence for the US. Pais brings it up because, in his view, it speaks to the importance of his own ideas about advanced physics.
